caption: The drawing features a maritime scene predominantly illustrated in shades of blue, pink, and black. The background is a flat light blue, representing the sky and sea. Two prominent lighthouses with pink and white facades, black windows, and black detailing stand on rocky outcrops at both the left and right edges of the image. The rocks surrounding the lighthouses are depicted in black and shades of pink. Near the center, there is a large sailing ship with multiple masts and billowing sails drawn in pink and outlined in white. To the right of this large ship, a smaller sailboat with less detail is visible on the waves. The waves are stylized, using swirling lines and accent colors in white and deep blue to indicate movement and foam. Above the central ship, the text "SANDY - HOOK" is written in dark blue. There are two outlined rectangular spaces in the upper section of the image, one empty oval toward the left and one empty rectangle toward the right. The entire composition sits within a larger cream or light beige border.
title: Bandbox
